This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the {{spin-off games}} [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Explorers of Time and Explorers of Darkness]] for the [[Nintendo DS]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Spike Chunsoft|Chunsoft]]. Names only present in certain regions are denoted in superscript.
